description: This Java class, PoliciesPersistenceStreamingActorCreator, is responsible for creating and configuring an Akka actor that streams information about persisted policies in the system. It provides methods to generate Props for the actor, and utilities to create PolicyTag objects and PidWithSeqNr instances based on entity IDs and revisions.
external_methods: DefaultPersistenceStreamingActor.props(Class<?> clazz, Function<PidWithSeqNr, PolicyTag> createElement, Function<EntityIdWithRevision, PidWithSeqNr> createPidWithSeqNr)

classes.name: PoliciesPersistenceStreamingActorCreator
classes.description: A factory class for creating the streaming actor with configured parameters and utility methods to generate policy tags and PidWithSeqNr objects.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates and returns the Props configuration needed to instantiate the actor, parameterized by the streaming cache size.

methods.name: createElement
methods.description: Converts a PidWithSeqNr object into a PolicyTag by extracting and converting the persistence ID.

methods.name: createPidWithSeqNr
methods.description: Creates a PidWithSeqNr instance from an EntityIdWithRevision object.
